title: 6 Signs Your Phone Has Replaced God as Your First Love
caption:
It rarely looks like idolatry. It just looks like Tuesday.

The first thing you touch in the morning is the screen, not a prayer. You reach for it in the silence before you've reached for God in it. You know your screen time to the minute and your last real prayer to the... you don't.

It's the last thing you check before sleep, and the last thing your soul hears. You've prayed for five minutes of self-control and given the app forty, same night. You'd feel the loss of your phone for a day faster than the loss of your quiet time for a month.

That's not preference. That's a first love, and it isn't Him.
